blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Alliance Global Group Inc. (AGI) grew its nine-month net income by 5 percent to P22.3 billion in 2026, driven by stronger brandy sales and higher leasing and hotel revenues, which boosted earnings in the third quarter. On Thursday, AGI said the increase was based on a year-earlier net income of P21.2 billion, after excluding one-time gains from the deconsolidation of Golden Arches Development Corp., the operator of McDonald’s Philippines.
